evidence: Offline native command sampling with independent bare Part027 forward geometry. External support torque model assumes centered 566 g mass at original z65 mm; does not include link or gear inertia, measured contact, actual COM, shaft tracking, voltage sag or motor current. Support margin is from the modeled center of pressure, not measured stability.

walk.stroke_basis: Recalculated for installed 35 mm carrier / 20 mm crank / 28 mm pickup / 38 mm rod / 55 mm leg and original shafts. Bare Part027 contacts the floor. 32 mm planted sweep, body Z +8.75 mm, 80 percent contact and phase-dependent body translation. Numerical source validation; loaded physical walking unqualified.

candidate_config.stroke_basis: Installed 35 mm carrier / 20 mm crank / 28 mm pickup / 38 mm rod / 55 mm bare Part027 leg and original shafts. 37 mm planted sweep, body Z +7 mm, 78 percent contact, phase-aligned support translation and 6-10 mm broader foot lift. Numerical source validation; loaded physical walking unqualified.
